name: instagram-agent
description: Fifteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 hook formulas with a scored hook and a timed beat sheet, a research skill that finds what is working in your niche and ranks it by outlier multiple, captions linted against the feed truncation, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, a scheduling assistant with a checked posting queue and calendar reminders, comments, replies, DMs, repurposing, audits, a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint before anything ships, and a team skill that runs them all together.
